newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fedex starts Paris-Moscow feeder this month.
newsitem.headline: Fedex starts Paris-Moscow feeder this month.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said it planned to launch a nightly Paris/CDG-Moscow air cargo feeder service later this month.
"The first flight on the Paris-Moscow route is scheduled for October 29 using one of our Boeing 727F aircraft," a FedEx official told Reuters.
The 727F can carry around 20 tonnes of cargo per flight.
The Paris-Moscow flight will be added to FedEx' existing network of intra-European 727F feeder flights which operate between CDG and Frankurt, Cologne, Milan and Basle.
Last month, FedEx launched a nightly Paris-Madrid route using a six-tonne capacity Fokker 27-500 aircraft leased from UK firm Channel Express Air Services.

FedEx earlier this year confirmed Paris as the European hub for its proposed round-the world delivery service. It also operates long-haul freighter services between CDG and New York and Memphis using a combination of McDonnell Douglas MD-11 and DC-10 aircraft.
